profile.summary: Zodiac Clothing Company Limited manufactures, retails, and trades men's clothing and accessories in India and internationally. The company provides shirts, ties, trousers, innerwear, polos, and jackets, as well as accessories, including cufflinks, pocket squares, belts, socks, and handkerchiefs.
